cardinality_note: A product may have one or more governed formulations.
description: Connects a product master to its formulation definition.

cardinality_note: A formulation uses many material masters.
description: Connects a formulation to API, excipient, and lubricant material masters.

cardinality_note: A recipe defines many ordered process steps.
description: Connects the recipe to CDC process steps.

cardinality_note: A run executes one recipe in this demo.
description: Connects execution evidence to the recipe definition.

cardinality_note: A run consumes one or more material lots.
description: Supports batch genealogy from run to input lots.

cardinality_note: A material lot instantiates one material master.
description: Separates lot-specific evidence from material master data.

cardinality_note: A reading should be recorded by one sensor.
description: Links readings to their instrument context.

cardinality_note: A reading belongs to one run context in this demo.
description: Places process evidence in an execution window.

cardinality_note: A QA release decision may release a run.
A QA rejection decision may reject a run.
A CDE value should instantiate one CDE definition.
description: Separates observed values from governed definitions.

cardinality_note: A CDE value should have one interpretation domain.
description: Links values to units, type expectations, and allowed values.

cardinality_note: A standard mapping should have at least one provenance statement.
description: Supports standards traceability for AI grounding.

cardinality_note: An evidence document may support many mappings.
description: Links document-style evidence to standard mapping records.

cardinality_note: An evidence document may support many CDE values.
description: Links document-style evidence to observed CDE values.
